scoring_justification: Structural bond lengths and symmetry recomputed from XYZ files; HOMO-LUMO gaps, Mulliken charges, and absolute binding energies compared to paper reference values with tolerances appropriate for DFT reproduction. Binding energy is additionally recomputed from total energy and agent's atomic energies for internal consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for bond lengths, HOMO-LUMO gaps, Mulliken charges, and binding energies.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 and Table 2 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's numerical tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact experimental quantities reported in the paper that the agent is expected to reproduce.

outputs.description: All computed structural, electronic, and energetic quantities for Si60F60 and Si60Cl60, along with the isolated-atom reference energies used to compute binding energies.

schema.description: XYZ file with 120 atoms (60 Si, 60 F). First line: integer (120); second line: comment; 120 coordinate lines, each with element symbol and x, y, z in Angstrom.

outputs.description: Final relaxed geometry of the Si60F60 cluster.

schema.description: XYZ file with 120 atoms (60 Si, 60 Cl). First line: integer (120); second line: comment; 120 coordinate lines, each with element symbol and x, y, z in Angstrom.

outputs.description: Final relaxed geometry of the Si60Cl60 cluster.

output_contract.notes: The symmetry field must be the string 'I_h'. All bond lengths, gaps, charges, and energies are compared to hidden reference values within tolerances appropriate for DFT reproduction. Structural consistency (bond lengths within tolerance, correct atom count) is also enforced.

steps.description: Verify Si60F60 geometry: atom and element counts, Ih symmetry via Si-Si bond uniformity, Si-F and Si-Si bond length ranges.
Verify Si60Cl60 geometry: atom and element counts, Ih symmetry, Si-Cl and Si-Si bond length ranges.
Verify results.json: recompute bond lengths from XYZ and compare to reported; compare HOMO-LUMO gaps, Mulliken charges, binding energies to paper gold; check internal consistency and physical trends.
